limiterDetail: The main limiter is a combination of wind and current. Wind: Ciron 14 kt (gusts 20), Nangalao 13.5 kt (gusts 18), Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 13 kt (gusts 18), Barangonan 13 kt, Linapacan 11 kt. Current: Decabaitot 1.2 kt, Alava 1.0, Barangonan 1.0 kt now; a short pulse of 1.2–1.4 kt returns about 2–5 AM Sun at Decabaitot, Alava and Barangonan. For reference, 9.7 kt is about 18 kph, the line fishermen treat as bad. Rain is light and not a factor (about 1 mm in the next day).

items: Wind eased and the VERY POOR grounds are gone: the mix is now 6 GOOD / 5 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (was 6 GOOD / 2 MARGINAL / 4 POOR / 4 VERY POOR). Nangalao and Cabunlawan dropped from 18–20 kt to 13.5 kt and are now MARGINAL. Decabaitot, Alava and Barangonan improved from VERY POOR to POOR (current 1.0–1.2 kt now, down from 1.5–1.6). The same six grounds stay GOOD: Tara, Decabobo, Turda, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan.

Regional wind: Sat 14 8.3 kt, gusts 13; Sun 15 8.2 kt, gusts 13 (GOOD day) ; Mon 16 12 kt, gusts 17; Tue 17 12 kt; Wed 18 5.9 kt (calmest); Thu 19 9.4 kt; Fri 20 15 kt, gusts 22 (rough). Supply: slightly soft today, near normal Sun, better Mon, near normal Tue to Thu. Shortage detector ELEVATED, surge OFF. PAGASA: CLEAR.

bestWindow.headline: Now through tonight at Tara, Decabobo, Turda and Panlaitan; Galoc, Coron and Culion from about 8 PM to 5 AM (wind 2–3 kt)
